text:
mira: FYI I'm starting onboarding for sable-13b (hf:open/sable-13b). Need perf intake + prioritization. Target: p95 <= 250ms for 512 tokens, high throughput for batch workloads. Any objections to putting this in the Q2 bench queue?
raj: +1, sounds good. Is this for Hosted/Dedicated/Private?
mira: Hosted first (smoke), then Dedicated for throughput SLA. Private only if enterprise request.
kevin: Can you drop expected typical prompt lengths & top-3 use cases?
mira: Typical prompts are 64-512 tokens (mostly ~128). Use cases: chat assistant (short-turn), code completion (mid-turn), summarization (longer).
anna: For perf intake checklist, we should run: cold start warmups, batching sweep, ctx len sweep, kv-cache stress, and quantization quality checks. Also collect memory footprint and GPU util.
mira: Agreed. Can we prioritize warmup/latency smoke + int8 quant smoke first?
raj: Prioritize: 1) latency smoke (batch=1, ctx 128/512), 2) batch throughput sweep (1/4/8/16), 3) ctx sweep (128/512/1024/2048), 4) int8 vs int4 quality spot-checks, 5) cold start warmup profile.
kevin: I'll own the batching sweep. I'll run perf harness across batch sizes and report p50/p95/p99 and throughput.
anna: I'll run quant experiments and CRT quality probes against our standard eval set (10 prompts per task). Will post delta metrics.
perfbot: deploy-bench started for sable-13b on g-pool-1 at 1705554390
mira: Posting runnable bench snippet for reference:
```
# perf harness example
python bench.py --model open/sable-13b --quant int8 --batch-sizes 1 4 8 16 --ctx-lens 128 512 1024 --out ./results/sable13b/
```
kevin: quick note — include an isolation run at batch=1 with kv-cache warm (single long convo) and cold (first request) to capture cold-start delta. Cold vs warm can be 2–4x in our infra.
anna: For quant quality checks: compare samples with fp16 baseline, compute exact-match/code-run for code tasks + rouge/bertscore for summarization. If int8 drops BLEU/BLEU-like or exec pass rate >5% relative, fail gating.
mira: SLA/targets: p95 <= 250ms (512 tokens), throughput target >= 200 tok/s on g4dn-xlarge equiv for batch 8 (approx). If we miss, propose: kernel changes, reduce seq-length, or fall back to a lighter quant profile.
raj: Add a tracking ticket in JIRA and tag eng-ml-bench. Also set rollout flag for canary-on-failure.
mira: I'll create the ticket and assign tasks. Tentative ETA for first smoke results: 48 hours.
kevin: I'll kick off the batch sweep in ~1h and paste raw csv + plot.
anna: Starting quant smoke now, will upload diffs.
perfbot: bench finished: initial smoke run complete at 1705554535 — p95 310ms (batch=1, ctx=512, int8) — baseline needed.
mira: noted — 310ms p95 is above target, but we need the full batch sweep. Thanks everyone.
raj: If p95 stays high, we'll open a perf triage and consider config changes (kernel flags, compile-opt).
mira: Closing loop: once kevin & anna post results, I'll update the intake ticket and set prioritization for Dedicated onboarding if fixes look manageable. :white_check_mark:
